name: @mos/jobs
description: MOS v2.0 durable-job authority (JOBS-001) + notification delivery plane (NOTIFY-001) — DurableJobRecord per §26/§30/§31 (tenant-scoped, §26 job kinds, artifact-ref inputs, lifecycle queued→running→succeeded|failed|cancelled|timed_out, declared retry policies), the JobQueuePort work-polling surface (idempotent enqueue by client job key, leased claims, heartbeats, typed complete/fail/cancel, retries driven from typed failures, dead-lettering with full append-only history), the DurableJobStorePort persistence seam, the ENG-003 runner-seam bridge adapter with §30 actor enrichment, and the notification plane: NotificationRecord (declarative kinds, identity-ref recipients, reference-only subjects, dedup-key idempotency, lifecycle queued→delivered|failed|suppressed), NotificationDeliveryPort (delivery attempts as RECORDED §30 events through the declared NotificationProviderPort transport seam, immutable receipts on success, typed retries with declared backoff otherwise, suppression with reasons as first-class recorded outcomes), NotificationStorePort + the disclosed in-memory doubles. No scheduling authority: workers poll claimNextRunnable; no task/workflow semantics on notifications.

scripts.test: tsc -b && node --test 'dist/**/*.test.js' && tsc -b ../mos-engines && tsc -p tsconfig.compat.json && node --test compat/engine-runner-bridge.test.ts
